class KpiInitializeModelLargeWorld:
    def peakmem_initialize_model_cpu(self, metrics=None):
        gc.collect()
    
        with wp.ScopedDevice("cpu"):
            model, pipeline, solver = self._initialize(10000)
    
        del model, pipeline, solver

    def setup_cache(self):
        # Warm CPU kernels for the separate peak-memory measurement.
        with wp.ScopedDevice("cpu"):
            self._initialize(4)
        if wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0:
            return None
    
        # Warm the measured configuration before collecting phase averages.
        workload = self._initialize(10000)
        del workload
        gc.collect()
        wp.synchronize_device()
    
        sample_times = []
        for _ in range(self.samples):
            phase_times = {}
            start_time = time.perf_counter()
            workload = self._initialize(10000, phase_times)
            phase_times["total"] = time.perf_counter() - start_time
            del workload
            gc.collect()
            wp.synchronize_device()
            sample_times.append(phase_times)
    
        return {name: fmean(times[name] for times in sample_times) for name in ("model", "finalize", "solver", "total")}

class FastBuildSdf:
    @skip_benchmark_if(wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0)
    def time_build_sdf(self, max_resolution):
        for _ in range(_BUILDS_PER_SAMPLE[max_resolution]):
            _build_sdf(self._mesh, max_resolution=max_resolution)
            # Release the SDF before the next iteration: ``build_sdf``
            # raises if the mesh already has one attached, and we want
            # each timed call to start from the same state.
            self._mesh.clear_sdf()
        wp.synchronize_device()

    def setup(self, max_resolution):
        wp.init()
        if wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0:
            # Matches the ``skip_benchmark_if`` guard on ``time_build_sdf``.
            return
    
        vertices, indices = _create_icosphere(radius=0.5, subdivisions=_SPHERE_SUBDIVISIONS)
    
        # Build the Newton mesh (and its BVH) once in setup so the timed
        # call measures only the SDF cook -- not mesh construction or BVH
        # rebuilds.
        self._mesh = newton.Mesh(vertices, indices, compute_inertia=False)
    
        # Extended warmup: multiple builds push the GPU into a sustained
        # boost-clock state, not just compile kernels.
        for _ in range(_WARMUP_BUILDS):
            self._mesh.clear_sdf()
            _build_sdf(self._mesh, max_resolution=max_resolution)
        self._mesh.clear_sdf()
        wp.synchronize_device()

    def setup(self, case):
        device = wp.get_device()
        if not device.is_cuda:
            raise SkipNotImplemented
    
        # ASV repeats setup per sample; collision-only graph replays preserve state.
        if getattr(self, "_case", None) == case:
            return
        self._case = None
    
        _name, kind, resolution, world_count, shape_count, sparse = case
        builder = newton.ModelBuilder()
        builder.replicate(
            _make_deformable_rigid_world(kind, resolution, shape_count, sparse),
            world_count,
        )
        self.model = builder.finalize(device=device)
        self.state = self.model.state()
        self.pipeline = newton.CollisionPipeline(
            self.model,
            broad_phase="nxn",
            soft_contact_gap=0.05,
            enable_rigid_soft_full_surface_contact=True,
            verify_buffers=False,

        self.contacts = self.pipeline.contacts()
    
        for _ in range(self.warmup_count):

                headless=True,

                use_cuda_graph=True,
                builder=builder,
                fps=self.physics_hz,
                sim_substeps=1,
                nconmax=self.nconmax,
            )
            if example.graph is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Realtime benchmark requires CUDA graph capture")
            for _ in range(self.warmup_steps):
                example.step()
            durations = []
            for _ in range(self.num_steps):
                start = time.perf_counter()
                example.step()
                durations.append(time.perf_counter() - start)
    
            example.test_final()
            data = example.solver.mjw_data
            contact_count = int(data.nacon.numpy()[0])
            if not 0 < contact_count <= data.naconmax:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Expected ground contacts within capacity {data.naconmax}, got {contact_count}")
        return durations

class _ResetWithStep:
    def time_reset_and_first_step(self, world_count, reset_count):
        self._reset_and_step()
        wp.synchronize_device(self.device)

    def setup(self, world_count, reset_count):
        super().setup(world_count, reset_count)
        # Check the reset state before any integration, then restore dirty input.
        self._reset()
        self._verify_reset(world_count)
        self._prepare_dirty(world_count)
        self.reference, _ = self._create_example(world_count)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.reference.model.joint_q.numpy(), self.example.model.joint_q.numpy())
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.reference.model.joint_qd.numpy(), self.example.model.joint_qd.numpy())
        assert self.reference.sim_dt == self.example.sim_dt
    
        # Compile one complete measured path and one direct reference step.
        self._reset_and_step()
        self.reference.state_0.clear_forces()
        self.reference.solver.step(
            self.reference.state_0,
            self.reference.state_1,
            self.reference.control,
            getattr(self.reference, "contacts", None),
            self.reference.sim_dt,
        )
        self.reference.state_0, self.reference.state_1 = self.reference.state_1, self.reference.state_0
    
        self._prepare_dirty(world_count)
        self._snapshot_reset_expected(world_count)
        ref_state = self.reference.state_0
        expected_q = self.dirty_q.copy()
        expected_q[self.selected] = self.target_q_np[self.selected]
        expected_qd = self.dirty_qd.copy()
        expected_qd[self.selected] = self.target_qd_np[self.selected]
        ref_state.joint_q.assign(expected_q.reshape(ref_state.joint_q.shape))
        ref_state.joint_qd.assign(expected_qd.reshape(ref_state.joint_qd.shape))
        newton.eval_fk(self.reference.model, ref_state.joint_q, ref_state.joint_qd, ref_state)
        for name in self._buffer_names:
            dirty = self.dirty_buffers[name].copy()
            dirty.reshape((world_count, -1))[self.selected] = 0.0
            getattr(self.reference.solver.mjw_data, name).assign(dirty)
    
        # The independent expected operation never calls _reset or a selection setter.
        ref_state.clear_forces()
        self.reference.solver.step(
            ref_state,
            self.reference.state_1,
            self.reference.control,
            getattr(self.reference, "contacts", None),
            self.reference.sim_dt,
        )
        self.reference.state_0, self.reference.state_1 = self.reference.state_1, ref_state
        self.poststep_expected = {
            name: getattr(self.reference.state_0, name).numpy().reshape((world_count, -1))
            for name in ("joint_q", "joint_qd", "body_q", "body_qd")
        }
        self.poststep_expected.update(
            {
                name: getattr(self.reference.solver.mjw_data, name).numpy().reshape((world_count, -1))
                for name in ("qpos", "qvel")
            }
        )
        wp.synchronize_device(self.device)

class _Reset:
    def setup(self, world_count, reset_count):
        if not wp.get_device().is_cuda:
            raise SkipNotImplemented
    
        self.example, self.view = self._create_example(world_count)
        self.solver = self.example.solver
        self.state = self.example.state_0
        self.state_out = self.example.state_1
        self.device = self.example.model.device
        assert not self.solver.use_mujoco_cpu
        assert not self.solver.enable_sleeping
    
        self.selected = np.zeros(world_count, dtype=bool)
        self.selected[:: world_count // reset_count] = True
        assert np.count_nonzero(self.selected) == reset_count
        self.view_mask = (
            None if reset_count == world_count else wp.array(self.selected, dtype=wp.bool, device=self.device)
        )
        self.world_mask = (
            None
            if reset_count == world_count
            else wp.array(np.append(self.selected, False), dtype=wp.bool, device=self.device)
        )
        self.fk_mask = None if self.view_mask is None else self.view.get_model_articulation_mask(self.view_mask)
    
        model = self.example.model
        self.target_q_np, self.target_qd_np, self.dirty_q, self.dirty_qd = self._make_joint_states(model, world_count)
        self.target_q = wp.array(self.target_q_np, dtype=wp.float32, device=self.device)
        self.target_qd = wp.array(self.target_qd_np, dtype=wp.float32, device=self.device)
    
        target_state = model.state()
        self.view.set_dof_positions(target_state, self.target_q)
        self.view.set_dof_velocities(target_state, self.target_qd)
        newton.eval_fk(model, target_state.joint_q, target_state.joint_qd, target_state)
        self.target_body = {
            name: getattr(target_state, name).numpy().reshape((world_count, -1)) for name in ("body_q", "body_qd")
        }
    
        # Compile the reset path, then make its timed input different from the target.
        self._reset()
        self._prepare_dirty(world_count)
        self._snapshot_reset_expected(world_count)
        wp.synchronize_device(self.device)

class SteelContactTorsionPreparation:
    @skip_benchmark_if(wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0)
    def time_prepare(self, contacts, patches):
        wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
        self._preparer.validate()

    def setup(self, contacts, patches):
        _require_cuda_graphs()
        if getattr(self, "_key", None) != (contacts, patches):
            from newton._src.solvers.steel.contact_torsion_device import DeviceTorsionPreparation  # noqa: PLC0415
            from newton.tests.steel._fixtures import synthetic_fixture  # noqa: PLC0415
    
            solver, *self._inputs = synthetic_fixture(worlds=1, witnesses=contacts, patches=patches, device="cuda:0")
            names = (
                "_constraint_count",
                "_slot_counter",
                "_row_type",
                "_row_parent",
                "_row_mu",
                "_phi",
                "_target_velocity",
                "_row_rebound_velocity",
                "_contact_torsion_group",
            )
            targets = [getattr(solver, name) for name in names] + list(solver._J_by_size.values())
            self._saved = [(target, wp.clone(target)) for target in targets]
            self._preparer = DeviceTorsionPreparation(solver, deferred_errors=True)
            self._restore()
            self._preparer.prepare(*self._inputs)
            self._expected = [target.numpy() for target, _ in self._saved]
            self._restore()
            with wp.ScopedCapture(device="cuda:0") as capture:
                self._preparer.prepare(*self._inputs)
            self.graph = capture.graph
            wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
            self._key = (contacts, patches)
        self._restore()
        wp.synchronize_device("cuda:0")

class SteelFrictionPair:
    @skip_benchmark_if(wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0)
    def time_pair_update(self, case):
        wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
        wp.synchronize_device("cuda:0")

    def setup(self, case):
        _require_cuda_graphs()
        rng = np.random.default_rng(102)
        n = self.pairs
        angle = rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, n)
        cosine, sine = np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)
        eigenvalue = rng.uniform(1.0, 8.0, n)
        blocks = np.column_stack(
            (cosine**2 + eigenvalue * sine**2, (1 - eigenvalue) * cosine * sine, sine**2 + eigenvalue * cosine**2)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        old = rng.uniform(-0.15, 0.15, (n, 2)).astype(np.float32)
        direction = rng.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi, n)
        sliding = np.full(n, case == "sliding") if case != "mixed" else rng.random(n) < 0.5
        target = np.column_stack((np.cos(direction), np.sin(direction))) * np.where(sliding, 2.0, 0.25)[:, None]
        self.sliding, self.target = sliding, target
        delta = old - target
        residuals = np.column_stack(
            (
                blocks[:, 0] * delta[:, 0] + blocks[:, 1] * delta[:, 1],
                blocks[:, 1] * delta[:, 0] + blocks[:, 2] * delta[:, 1],
            )
        ).astype(np.float32)
        with wp.ScopedDevice("cuda:0"):
            # The graph reads these by address, so they live as long as it does.
            self.inputs = [
                wp.array(blocks, dtype=wp.vec3),
                wp.array(residuals, dtype=wp.vec2),
                wp.array(old, dtype=wp.vec2),
            ]
            self.out = wp.empty(2 * n, dtype=float)
            wp.launch(_friction_pair_update, dim=n, inputs=self.inputs, outputs=[self.out])
            with wp.ScopedCapture() as capture:
                for _ in range(self.launches):
                    wp.launch(_friction_pair_update, dim=n, inputs=self.inputs, outputs=[self.out])
            self.graph = capture.graph
            wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
            wp.synchronize_device()

class SteelFrictionPatchBuild:
    @skip_benchmark_if(wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0)
    def time_build(self, tiles, world_count):
        wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
        wp.synchronize_device(self.scene.model.device)

    def setup(self, tiles, world_count):
        _require_cuda_graphs()
        if getattr(self, "_key", None) == (tiles, world_count):
            return
        scene = _TiledBodyScene(world_count, tiles)
        for _ in range(10):
            scene.step_pair()
        solver = scene.solver
        patches = solver._friction_patches
    
        def build():
            patches.build(
                scene.model,
                scene.state_0,
                scene.contacts,
                shape_material_mu=solver._shape_mu,
                contact_gap_limit=solver._contact_gap_limit,
                friction_gap_limit=solver._friction_gap,
                dt=scene.dt,
            )
    
        build()
        with wp.ScopedCapture(device=scene.model.device) as capture:
            for _ in range(self.launches):
                build()
        self.graph = capture.graph
        self.scene = scene
        wp.capture_launch(self.graph)
        wp.synchronize_device(scene.model.device)
        self._key = (tiles, world_count)

class FastViewerGL:
    @skip_benchmark_if(wp.get_cuda_device_count() == 0)
    def time_rendering_frame(self, robot, world_count):
        # Rendering one frame
        self.renderer.begin_frame(0.0)
        self.renderer.log_state(self._state)
        self.renderer.end_frame()
        wp.synchronize_device()

    def setup(self, robot, world_count):
        wp.init()
        builder = Example.create_model_builder(robot, world_count, randomize=True, seed=123)
    
        # finalize model
        self._model = builder.finalize()
        self._state = self._model.state()
    
        # Setting up the renderer
        self.renderer = ViewerGL(headless=True)
        self.renderer.set_model(self._model)
        # Render once so the timed frame is a steady one.
        self.time_rendering_frame(robot, world_count)
